arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in 2019, the current year in this data. The count includes transactions with and without fraud labels.
assumptions: 'This year' is 2019, resolved against the last day of the data (2019-10-31).
The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so the count is for January to October 2019.
The count includes all transactions, including those without a fraud label.
